infotexts.missionname.mission_escort_jtfcrewtransp: Justice Task Force on the move!
infotexts.missiondescription.mission_escort_hoshin: Apparently Hoshino got left behind when her group about to board the last trip. What are these girls doing in Europa and why are they heading towards the abyss? Matter not, it's a good thing to help a stranger who is in trouble.\n\n ‖color:gui.blue‖Hoshino‖end‖ ‖color:gui.orange‖will board your ship for this mission.‖end‖
infotexts.missiondescription.mission_escort_jtfcre: The three girls from the ‖color:#f21f20‖Justice Task Force‖end‖ needed you to escorts them to one of the designated outpost, they needed to meet up with their field captain, ‖color:gui.blue‖Nakamasa Ichika‖end‖.\n\n ‖color:gui.orange‖Bring all 3 girls to safety of the target outpost.‖end‖
infotexts.missiondescription.missionevent_gehennas: Ichika has tasked you with destroying the Interceptor. The Interceptor operates within the outskirt of this location.
infotexts.missiondescription.mission_gehenna_inter: To accesses the Interceptor, you'll need to destroy all of it's cannon's ‖color:gui:orange‖power grids‖end‖ outside, next to the weapons them self using explosives or EMP. Once all cannons are destroyed, the hatch in the back will open, but careful as the enemy inside are heavily armed.
infotexts.missiondescription.hostile_gehenna_scout: Gehenna scout sub marines operates in this water.\n\n(Optional) Defeat Gehenna Scout Submarine
infotexts.missiondescription.attackgehennaoutpost1: Ichika has tasked you to deal with an outpost ( this is a test mission )
